# APC 10x5E blade geometry - REAL MEASUR: # rather than a series table or a guess.
# APC's own definitions
#   PITCH (QUOTED)   angular measure defined with a flat bottom surface (= input pitch)
#   PITCH (LE-TE)    defined by leading- and trailing-edge mould parting-line datums
#   PITCH (PRATHER)  what a pitch gauge resting on the lower surface would read
#   SWEEP(Y)/RAKE(Z) defined with the mould LE parting line
#   TWIST            defined with the LE and TE mould parting-line datums
#   CHORD            length between the LE and TE mould parting lines
#   ZHIGH            highest elevation on the top surface
#   CGY / CGZ        mass offset
# Lengths in INCHES as published. r_R and c_D added here for convenience:
#   r_R = station / 5.0 in
c_D = chord / 10.0 in.  D = 10.0 in = 254.0 mm.

# APC 10x5E blade geometry - REAL MEASUR: # CAUTION - thickness ratio at the root is 0.40
# The brief assumes "t/c 14% at the root tapering to 9% at the tip". The real blade is far
# thicker inboard because the aerofoil blends into the hub boss there. Trust this file over
# the brief's figure
and do not loft the inboard stations as if they were aerofoils.
